description: One line of a recall qrels JSONL file. Grade meanings: 0 = irrelevant: shares no mechanism and no precondition; 1 = related: same equipment or site, different recurrence condition; 2 = highly relevant: shares the mechanism or the precondition; 3 = perfectly relevant: shares mechanism and precondition; this is the precursor. Grades >= 2 count as relevant for binary metrics.

blinded.description: True when the judge could not see which system retrieved the document. P@block is only computed over blinded judgements.
blinded.title: Blinded

gold_set.description: Gold set this judgement belongs to, e.g. G1, G2, G3, G4, GS0.
gold_set.title: Gold Set

judged_at.description: When the judgement was recorded, if known.
judged_at.title: Judged At

judged_by.description: Provenance. LLM-only labels never ship as a precision headline.
judged_by.title: Judged By

scale.description: Rubric the grade was produced under.
scale.title: Scale

title: TRAPPOINT recall relevance judgement (UMBRELA 0-3)
